notes: NDM 1.5.2 — three fixes. (1) The browser bridge could fail to open the app when it was closed (a launcher false-success in the .deb layout); the app now opens every time. (2) "Sent to NDM" is now honest: the pill turns green only when the app itself confirms it showed the download dialog — otherwise it says Queued. (3) A finished video is now checked for sound: if the merged file lost its audio track, the download is marked as an error instead of Finished.
